summary: Rusk County tower for the Wisconsin Conservation Department; 110-ft steel ladder tower erected 1952; FFLA lists it gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date found in the sources read

events.note: Sheboygan Press item (May 31, 1932): fire lane under construction southeast of Birchwood; state-authorized tower not yet started
DNR invited sealed bids for the Birchwood fire tower (Rusk Co.); the notice gives its height as about 100 feet

evidence.supports: built 1952 as a 110-foot ladder-type steel tower
evidence.quote: 1952: A 110-foot ladder type steel tower erected.

evidence.supports: agency was the Wisconsin Conservation Department
May 31, 1932: fire lane under construction southeast of Birchwood; state-authorized tower not yet started
evidence.quote: A fire lane which will be three miles in length when completed, is being constructed southeast of Birchwood, Wis. Construction of the fire tower authorized by the state conservation commission has not been started.

evidence.supports: January 6, 1983: DNR invited sealed bids for a fire tower at Birchwood (Rusk Co.)
evidence.quote: January 6, 1983: Sealed bids will be received by the State of Wisconsin, Department of Natural Resources at the Park Falls DNR Area Headquarter located at Park Falls, Wisconsin for a fire tower situated at the following location: Birchwood Fire Tower

evidence.supports: 1983 notice gives approximate height of about 100 feet
evidence.quote: Approximate height of the steel fire tower is 100 feet.

evidence.supports: listed as gone, at 45.59402, -91.53159 in Rusk County

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1952 erection is given as 110 feet (33.5 m); the January 1983 bid notice gives an approximate 100 feet. The record keeps the 110-foot as-built figure.

notes_for_editor: Only one history source (the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes 1932 and 1983 newspaper items and gives a 1952 erection date with no source named for it). The 1983 notice invites bids for the Birchwood fire tower but does not say what the bid covered, so the story does not say the tower was sold or removed. No staffing, fire, access or removal-date information in the sources read. The OSM node (353894364) and data/sources/osm.json label the point 'standing', but that is only map presence, not evidence, and it conflicts with the FFLA 'Gone' listing; not used. The statewide DNR decommissioning (2015 per WJFW, 2016 per Sawyer County Record) is not applied because no source ties it to Birchwood. Record height_m 33.5 kept.
